rules.title: Structured JSON logs
rules.text: Emit logs as structured JSON, one object per line, with timestamp, level, message and context fields.

rules.title: logfmt logs
rules.text: Emit logs in logfmt (key=value pairs), one event per line.

rules.title: Plain text logs
rules.text: Emit human-readable plain text logs with timestamp and level.

rules.title: Use log levels correctly
rules.text: Use levels consistently: error for failures needing action, warn for recoverable problems, info for lifecycle events, debug for diagnostics.

rules.title: Never log secrets or PII
rules.text: Never log secrets, tokens, passwords or personal data; redact before logging.

rules.title: Correlation IDs
rules.text: Attach a request or correlation ID to every log line in a request scope.

rules.title: No leftover debug output
rules.text: Remove debug prints and console.log calls before finishing; use the project logger.

rules.title: Log errors with context
rules.text: Log errors once, at the boundary that handles them, with enough context to reproduce.
